key_metric: The FY2026 guidance action: whether adjusted diluted EPS of $6.40-6.80 and comparable sales of 0% to +2% are held, narrowed or cut. Street FY adj EPS already sits ~$6.39, below the $6.60 guide midpoint, and the guide implies H2 adj EPS of $3.35-3.75 vs $3.11 last year (+14% at the midpoint). Secondary: August/Q3 quarter-to-date comp colour, given JD Sports reported back-to-school demand deferred out of July into early August, i.e. out of the quarter that ended 2026-08-01.
